name: 局所分散マップ
description: Analyzes the spatial distribution of local intensity variance. AI images tend to have more uniform variance distributions across the image.
mechanism: Computes variance in local blocks and analyzes distribution. AI images show less natural variation in texture complexity.
parameters: Block size: 16x16, Metric: coefficient of variation
useCase: Detecting uniform variance patterns in AI-generated content

references.title: Mahdian, B. & Saic, S. (2009). Using Noise Inconsistencies for Blind Image Forensics. Image and Vision Computing.
Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing Digital Forgeries in Color Filter Array Interpolated Images. IEEE TSP.
Pan, X. et al. (2011). Region Duplication Detection Using Image Feature Matching. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Simple and intuitive noise characterization
• Reveals spatial noise inconsistencies
• Fast sliding-window computation
• Effective for detecting spliced regions
• Complementary to frequency-domain noise analysis
limitations:
• Cannot distinguish noise source types
• Textured regions naturally have high variance
• Window size selection affects spatial resolution
• Sensitive to image content edges and textures
• Post-processing homogenizes variance patterns
